alpha_support: Every alpha value >0, without threshold relaxation
allowed_transform: Integer dy>=0 only; same dy for both rows and continuation marks in each group; exact alpha translation, no rerasterization
clearance: No lyric support within Chebyshev distance <=1 of any fixed score ink; minimum pixel-center distance >=2. This dilation is a spacing test only, not added ink or ownership.
optimizer: Enumerate complete finite dy domain 0..viewport_bottom-group_bottom. Cross-correlate translated lyric support against fixed spacing obstacle and baseline neighboring lyric support. Select minimum feasible dy; report every forbidden smaller dy. No iterative post-result adjustment.
local: Group by printed measure. Move only groups failing original spacing predicate. Neighbors remain baseline obstacles; validate all final pairwise lyric masks and fail closed on any conflict. Measure 3 is immutable and must already satisfy spacing.
global: Translate all 40 lyric components by one minimal feasible dy. This new alternative explicitly changes measure 3 when dy>0; historical outputs never change.
final_selection: Use local candidate if all checks pass; otherwise BLOCKED, no fallback retuning. Global remains separately labeled alternative.
required: Zero lyric/music and lyric/lyric contacts, no clipping or lost alpha, unchanged x anchors, row spacing and associations; unchanged full V3 guard; anchor criterion <=0.5 per axis
inspection: Agent inspection after prediction freeze; not independent human optical validation
unresolved: Outgoing cross-system tie remains unrendered; no destination invention
